text_block_list.text:
One day, as those three precious years for
Narita Taishin were drawing to a close,
her sudden words made me doubt my own ears.
choice_data_list: Does that mean, like... career counseling?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're overreacting.
It's not that big of a deal.
Right now, racing comes first anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Still, you've been putting up solid results lately. So maybe it's about time you started looking further ahead...?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's with that look on your face?
It's pissing me off...

She used to be driven primarily by the urge to 'show them all!', but now she's looking to the future.
I could tell she was gradually changing, but...
Could this also be the influence of the battles in the Twinkle Series, Dr. Reits, and my companions?

"Regardless, the more options we have, the better!
Beyond the Twinkle Series, there should be limitless possibilities...!"
choice_data_list: Since we're doing this, how about giving me the entire day?!
If it's all the same to you, could you give me the whole day?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean, one day...?
—And on the weekend, we first gathered in the school library!
choice_data_list: I've gathered the materials for you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what's this? College brochures, and...
"Job Encyclopedia for Students"...?
You didn't need to gather an entire mountain of them.
choice_data_list: For now, you should just borrow the ones that catch your eye.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
A career path tied to gaming, cats, and cooking...
A major where I can research napping?
Wait, no, no, no...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, sure, they're all hobbies of mine, but...
If you ask whether I want to do them seriously, well, hmm...

In the afternoon, we went outside the academy
and toured various places!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Transferring to the Dream Trophy League
seems like the hottest option right now, I guess...
I still wanna keep running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "Still, you've gotta think about what comes after all that, you know? After all, everyone retires someday."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I'm staying involved in racing long-term... maybe an instructor?
Teaching others definitely doesn't suit me, though... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this place is for little kids!
A "Job Experience Park"...?
Are you seriously considering this?
choice_data_list: If you keep overthinking it, you'll just hit a wall!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaah, honestly... Well, if it's like a game, I guess I wouldn't mind doing it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... A new flower shop opened.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, your family runs a flower shop.
Come to think of it, your family runs a flower shop.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: “I see... 'Inheriting' it too, huh...? Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever talked about that with my parents.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... you must have avoided bringing it up until now
so that I could stay focused on my races...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... This is so haaaard...
"Taking a break inside the cafe, she let out a gentle sigh."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
......
Hey, just out of curiosity...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What about you?
Don't you have anything you want to do
besides being my Trainer?

Told that, I try to think about it. Having her thrive
in her races is my number one dream, but
is there anything else I want to do...? Another dream...?

I want Narita Taishin to win next time, too.
I want her to run a race she's satisfied with.
And most of all, I want her to be happy—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What is that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haa...! You're such a complete idiot!
choice_data_list: Well, nothing else came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Then doesn't that mean I gotta work hard for it?
Even though it's your dream... geez.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I learned a lot of helpful things today.
I'll thank you, for what it's worth. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll think about it carefully.
I've still got the Arima Kinen ahead of me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... There's gotta be something.
Something besides racing... for me too..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: After finally proving them wrong, having nothing to show for it after that would be super lame.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?!
Why are you tearing up?! So annoying!
